name: ycb_material_mfcc_logmel

output.scores: SVM margins (binary [-margin,+margin], multiclass sklearn OVR); NOT calibrated probabilities
output.class_index: index into classes; use this rather than score argmax for SVC vote ties

contract.waveform: 1s peak20ms-centered16kHz; YCB decode and resample; RealImpact force-deconvolved48kHz->16kHz then .95 peak normalize
contract.license: YCB source node_license null, rights review required
limits: Small controlled robot/gripper airborne recordings, not phone material identification or tile bonding.
Each source clip contains multiple pokes; one peak-centered excerpt is scored. No claim to reproduce paper segmentation or full-dataset results.
Only three objects per class, nested tuning has one training object per class. Split uncertainty is large; objects differ in shape/content as well as material.
Soft-plastic fruit are YCB manufactured replicas, not real fruit ripeness.
Source node_license null: local research only; no redistribution or commercial license inferred.
No iPhone/Core ML conversion, latency, energy, or on-device memory measured.

training.selection: all-data training-only object-rank CV; no outer-score family winner

performance_claim: Deployment fitted on every cached observation. No deployment training-set accuracy presented as held-out performance.

verification_fixture.schema: features float32[N,D], scores float64[N,K], class_index int32[N], classes[K], source_indices[N]; <=8 real rows
